name: zudo-design-token-panel-example-zfb
description: zfb (zudo-front-builder) example app demonstrating @takazudo/zdtp — host-config-driven panel mounted as a Preact island via zfb's Island component, plus apply-pipeline round-trip via a devMiddleware plugin that proxies to the bin sidecar.

scripts.dev: lsof -ti:44327 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -ti:24685 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; concurrently -k -n zfb,tokens-bin -c blue,green "pnpm run _dev:zfb" "pnpm run _dev:tokens-bin"
